sourceMarkup: {{EventEnded|date = 29th of October 2020|event = [[Spring 2020 Event]]}} {{CurrencyInfobox |title = Ticket |image = Tickets.png |type = {{Color|Event}} }} ==Description== '''Ticket''' was used during the [[Christmas 2019 Event]] and [[Spring 2020 Event]] to purchase items in the [[Event Store]]. They were rewarded upon the completion of [[Village of Despair]] and [[Eggy Island]], respectively, during these events. '''Tickets''' have not been used since the [[Spring 2020 Event]]. It took the appearance of a red ticket with yellow stars on it. ==Trivia== *'''Tickets''' are the only event currency to have been used for two events, as all others have been exclusive to one event. ==Update History== *'''24 December 2019''' - [[Release v1.5|Release v1.5.0]] **'''Ticket''' added. *'''11 February 2020''' - [[Release v1.6|Release v1.6.1]] **'''Ticket''' removed. *'''6 April 2020''' - [[Release v1.9|Release v1.9.0]] **'''Ticket''' re-added, as part of the [[Spring 2020 Event]]. *'''26 May 2020''' - [[Release v1.11|Release v1.11.0]] **'''Ticket''' removed. {{CurrencyNavBox}}
